bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
wt="$(pwd -P)/.worktrees/notice-live-20261127"
test -d "$wt"
test -z "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain)" || { echo NOTICE_WORKTREE_DIRTY; exit 46; }
test "$(git -C "$wt" remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#\.git$##; s#^git@github.com:#https://github.com/#')" = 'https://github.com/seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot' || { echo NOTICE_ORIGIN_MISMATCH; exit 47; }
git -C "$wt" fetch origin fix/notice-live-adopted-20261127
target=ce50d5e1b755b374b7527d895e2fd7246f565cfc
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$target" || { echo NOTICE_REMOTE_HEAD_MISMATCH; exit 45; }
git -C "$wt" merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "$target" || { echo NOTICE_WORKTREE_DIVERGED; exit 46; }
git -C "$wt" merge --ff-only "$target"
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$target"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
echo NOTICE_SOURCE_SHA="$target"
tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:notice-stage-ce50d5e1
docker build --pull=false --progress=plain -f "$wt/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t "$tag" "$wt" || { echo NOTICE_DOCKER_BUILD_FAILED; exit 51; }
docker image inspect -f 'NOTICE_IMAGE_ID={{.Id}} USER={{.Config.User}}' "$tag"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' "$tag")" = node
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$tag" --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
echo NOTICE_PR81_IMAGE_STAGED=PASS
